Tenure 2026–27 • PELS Core

Whether you are applying for Technical & Projects, Operations, Events, Design, or Finance—our junior core is built on proactive ownership.

The Interview Experience

Five minutes to share your curiosity.

Each candidate is allocated a dedicated 5-minute interaction with our panel leads. Be genuine, test your microphone and webcam ahead of time.

Checklist & Preparation

Everything you need before joining.

Audio & Camera Ready

Ensure your microphone and webcam are functional. We conduct all junior core interviews face-to-face over Google Meet.

Punctual Entry

Join the Google Meet 3 minutes prior to your allocated slot. Each slot is strictly 5 minutes to keep timing on schedule.

Confidence & Honesty

Don't worry if you don't know every technical term yet. We look for curiosity, initiative, and eagerness to learn together.
